# World Battery Hub — Testing

> Battery testing methodology reference — 24 testing-method guides covering capacity, CCA, impedance, safety/abuse, environmental, and cycle-life testing, plus a standards index. Sub-site of the World Battery Hub family.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/): Entry point to the battery testing reference.
- [Capacity Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/capacity-testing/): Capacity test methods and interpretation.
- [CCA Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/cca-testing/): Cold cranking amps test procedures.
- [Load Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/load-testing/): Load test methodology.
- [Impedance Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/impedance-testing/): Internal impedance and conductance measurement.
- [Resistance / Conductance](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/resistance-conductance/): Resistance vs conductance test comparison.
- [Conductance vs Load Test](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/conductance-vs-load-test/): When to use each test method.
- [Charge Acceptance](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/charge-acceptance/): Charge acceptance testing.
- [Self-Discharge Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/self-discharge-testing/): Self-discharge rate measurement.
- [C-Rate Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/c-rate-testing/): C-rate and rate-capability testing.
- [Capacity Rates](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/capacity-rates/): Capacity at different discharge rates.
- [Reserve Capacity](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/reserve-capacity/): Reserve capacity testing.
- [Degradation Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/degradation-testing/): Cycle-life and degradation testing.
- [Cycle Safety](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/cycle-safety/): Safety during charge/discharge cycling.
- [BMS Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/bms-testing/): Battery management system validation.
- [Abuse Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/abuse-testing/): Abuse and destructive testing.
- [Short-Circuit Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/short-circuit-testing/): Short-circuit safety testing.
- [Thermal Shock Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/thermal-shock-testing/): Thermal shock cycling.
- [Temperature Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/temperature-testing/): Temperature-dependent performance testing.
- [Vibration Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/vibration-testing/): Vibration and mechanical stress testing.
- [Pressure Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/pressure-testing/): Pressure and venting tests.
- [Leak Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/leak-testing/): Leak detection methods.
- [Insulation Resistance Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/insulation-resistance-testing/): Insulation resistance measurement.
- [Acceptance Testing](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/acceptance-testing/): Incoming/inspection acceptance testing.
- [Standards](https://testing.worldbatteryhub.com/standards/): Index of battery testing standards.

## Main site

- [World Battery Hub](https://worldbatteryhub.com/): Main knowledge hub (guides, tools, glossary, methodology).

## Notes

- Testing procedures are general reference descriptions, not certification instructions; always follow the applicable standard's published test protocol for compliance work.
